NPR, 24 June 2026: https://www.npr.org/2026/06/24/g-s1-129770/iran-nuclear-inspection
IAEA Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi: "I can understand political statements, they are part of the reality, but the fundamental thing I would like to remind you and draw your attention to is that there has been a memorandum of understanding, signed by both presidents."
Grossi on the accord: it "says explicitly that the nuclear activities that are going to be carried out with regards to the nuclear material facilities will be supervised by the IAEA — in all letters." And: "Obviously, to do that, we will have to inspect."

An Iranian diplomat rejected this, saying such a visit can only come after a final deal.

Grossi (snippet): IAEA inspectors have not yet returned to Iran's nuclear facilities; the agency believes Iran's stockpile of enriched uranium remains at the sites. The IAEA had requested access but had not received permission to return.

Al Jazeera, 2 July 2026: Iran bars IAEA inspectors from bombed sites Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan.

IAEA Board of Governors report GOV/2026/8, dated 27 February 2026: https://www.iaea.org/sites/default/files/gov2026-8.pdf (not retrieved)
